includes.description: Changed-root repository-relative patterns. Omission inherits the lower-precedence list; an empty array selects no roots.

privacyExcludes.description: Additional protected-path exclusions. These accumulate and cannot be overridden by lower-privacy layers.

credentialEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable that supplies the review credential. Store the secret value outside configuration.

inspectionRetentionDays.description: User-owned capture-aged inspection retention in days, shared across residents and projects.

inspectionStorageBytes.description: User-owned shared allocated inspection-storage cap, including records, indices, payloads and temporary allocations. Unavailable quota drops capture; review continues.

claudeFeedbackMode.description: Claude PostToolUse feedback. Blocking current findings requires an explicit user configuration opt-in; a project may only restrict it to advisory.

virtualRoundQuietMs.description: Continuous fully quiet time before an open virtual round closes without Stop, in milliseconds. User configuration only; captured when the round opens.

title: Review configuration v1
description: JSONC configuration for file selection, import exploration limits, rules, and credential references.

ReviewBackendSettings.description: User-owned review destination and provider-specific model/account selection. Projects cannot set this field.

AnalyticsRecordingEnabled.description: Opt-in source-free session analytics. Project configuration overrides the user default; disabled by default; subject to the shared activity storage limits.

InspectionRecordingEnabled.description: Opt-in source-bearing local inspection history. Project configuration overrides the user default in either direction; independent of source-free analytics and disabled by default. Opening the dashboard never enables recording.

perAdvicee.description: Maximum simultaneously pending edit permits for one advicee in the shared resident.

resident.description: Maximum simultaneously pending edit permits across the shared resident.

EditPermitLimitsSettings.description: User-owned shared resident admission limits. Omitted values use built-in defaults.

sourceBytes.description: Maximum source bytes in each graph file.

files.description: Maximum files read, including the root.

readBytes.description: Maximum total source bytes read; must be at least sourceBytes.

outgoingEdges.description: Maximum outgoing edges per accepted file.

GraphLimitsSettings.description: Import graph limits; omitted values inherit.
